details.label: Summary
details.text: Storms are likely to increase in coverage over Lower Michigan, eventually developing southeastward across Lake Erie and neighboring states. Corridors of damaging wind will be the primary risk

details.label: Discussion
details.text: Strong destabilization has occurred over southern Lower MI south of warm front. Radar trends show an initial large cluster of storms anchored near this front, with additional echoes developing to the southwest. Given the position of the instability gradient and west/northwest flow aloft, these developing storms should move southeast/rightward into the afternoon. Sensors indicate robust precipitable water as well, with over 1.80" over Lower MI. This, along with steepening boundary layer lapse rates, will favor strong to severe outflow production downstream. As such, a watch may be needed soon

details.label: Most probable threats
details.text: MOST PROBABLE PEAK TORNADO INTENSITY...UP TO 90 MPH · MOST PROBABLE PEAK WIND GUST...65-80 MPH · MOST PROBABLE PEAK HAIL SIZE...UP TO 1.25 IN
